ogre.desc: A mountain of stitched hide and old bruises shambles into reach, breath sour with rot-meat and stolen ale. Its greatclub is a fence post still crusted with the last thing it hit. Small eyes track motion before thought — hunger runs this body, not cunning, and it will close distance faster than its bulk suggests.

rows.text: Half-drunk on looted spirits — swings wide, but hits like a wall regardless.
Nurses a festering spear wound; favors its off side, slower to close.
Drags a crude cage-cart of stolen livestock, unwilling to abandon it.
Wears a dead knight's dented breastplate as a trophy, laces never done up right.
Travels with a starving dire wolf pup it half-remembers to feed.
Its club is a broken windmill blade lashed to a felled tree — swings wider than a body should let it.
Bone charms rattle at its neck; it flinches from firelight like something taught it to.
Skin scarred in old brands from a fighting pit — it remembers the crowd's noise and roars for one now.
